blinding_contract: new judgment input exposes only neutral case identity, frozen purpose and lexical query, parent snapshot identity, neutral resource identity/address, and exact parent-snapshot content
new judgment input omits lexical rank and score, retrieval origin, overlap, changed paths, post-change content, retrieval labels, diagnostics, and labels for other resources
reused judgment pairs are excluded from new judgment requests

canonical_rankings_prior_rank_agreement.status: all retained ranks and available scores agree

payload.pool_rule: positive canonical lexical ranks 1 through min(50, positive result count), union by exact (case_id, resource address)

usefulness_semantics.not_useful: not useful for the frozen InformationNeed purpose
usefulness_semantics.unjudged: no usefulness outcome; never coerced to not-useful
usefulness_semantics.useful: useful for the frozen InformationNeed purpose
